'''Ban Wan Pollo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sympathies who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. Wan Pollo got himself into debt with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], and so sought out backup before making his next payment; the presence of his allies helped Wan Pollo renegotiate the terms of his contract with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="Mission" />
